hooks.name: RSpec on File Save
hooks.description: Runs the corresponding RSpec spec when a .rb file is saved. If the saved file is a spec, runs it directly. Otherwise resolves the matching spec under spec/.

action.command: bash -c 'FILE="$1"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q "_spec\\.rb$"; then bundle exec rspec "$FILE" --format progress 2>&1 | tail -20; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q "^app/"; then SPEC=$(echo "$FILE" | sed "s|^app/|spec/|; s|\\.rb$|_spec.rb|"); [ -f "$SPEC" ] && bundle exec rspec "$SPEC" --format progress 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo "No spec found for $FILE"; fi' -- "${file}"
